name: Marco Becattini
biography: I am a PhD student in Smart Computing at the University of Florence, Italy 🇮🇹, where I am part of the Software Technologies Laboratory (STLab) in the Department of Information Engineering, under the supervision of Prof. Enrico Vicario. I also collaborate with Prof. Nuno Laranjeiro from the Department of Informatics Engineering (DEI) at the University of Coimbra, Portugal 🇵🇹.

My research investigates how software engineering principles and techniques can be adapted to design and govern LLM-based multi-agent systems, with a focus on the themes of reliability and performance.
My work combines architectural approaches with empirical studies in industry, particularly in telecommunications, and in educational settings.
When I am not in front of a Mac, I am usually surfing, reading C.G. Jung, or mixing cocktails.
interests: Reliability and performance in LLM-based multi-agent systems
